title: Licence to fell or remove produce
rule: Except under a licence, no one may cut, fell or remove forest produce from a forest reserve. Felling what the Act or Regulations prohibit needs the Director's written permission.
points: The licence form is in the First and Second Schedules.
The Licensing Officer may order the licensee to afforest or re-forest the felled area.
checks: Licence in the Second Schedule form
